english: Six observations $a,ar,ar^2,ar^3,ar^4,ar^5$, where $a>0$ and $r$ is a positive real number with $r\neq1$, are in geometric progression. The arithmetic mean of all six observations is $\dfrac45$ times the arithmetic mean of the three observations $a,ar^2,ar^4$. Then the value of $r$ is ______.
hindi: छः प्रेक्षण $a,ar,ar^2,ar^3,ar^4,ar^5$, जहाँ $a>0$ तथा $r$ एक धनात्मक वास्तविक संख्या है और $r\neq1$, गुणोत्तर श्रेढ़ी में हैं। सभी छः प्रेक्षणों का समान्तर माध्य, तीन प्रेक्षणों $a,ar^2,ar^4$ के समान्तर माध्य का $\dfrac45$ गुना है। तब $r$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Mean of all six: $\dfrac{a(1+r)(1+r^2+r^4)}{6}$. Mean of $a,ar^2,ar^4$: $\dfrac{a(1+r^2+r^4)}{3}$.
Check with $a=1$: the six terms sum to $\dfrac{1-0.6^6}{0.4}=2.38336$, mean $0.397227$; the odd-position terms $1,0.36,0.1296$ have mean $0.496533$, and $0.8\times0.496533=0.397227$.
originality_note: New: the mean of a six-term GP compared with the mean of its alternate terms; the GP sum splits as (1 + r)(1 + r^2 + r^4), so the ratio of the means is (1 + r)/2 (way 4: a hidden factorisation makes the condition linear). Closest known: 'ratio of the sum of first three to first six terms of a GP'. Different because: the alternate terms form their own GP with ratio r^2 and the comparison is between means of different sizes. (First design, five-term GP with given mean and mean of reciprocals, was found online and replaced.)
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Stated r > 0 and r != 1 so that the GP sum formula applies and the answer is unique. Changed: replaced the first design after the web check.
key_step: Factorising r^6 - 1 so that the GP sum is (1 + r) times the sum of the alternate terms.
justification: Routine GP sum work with one factorisation; numerical format. Comparable to the L2 statistics anchor 2026-P2-Q12 and easier than the L4 sequence anchors.

concept_use.Arithmetic mean of ungrouped data: The two means are sums divided by 6 and by 3.
concept_use.Geometric Progression (GP) & Sum of GP: S6 = a(r^6 - 1)/(r - 1) and the sum of the alternate terms a(1 + r^2 + r^4).
